|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-kananjarrus.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V3-L-kananjarrus-2022-12-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V3-L-kananjarrus-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V3-L-kananjarrus-2022-12-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V3-L-kananjarrus.gif]], 1 December 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark; the words are the same as the previous version.
* '''Original''' ([[Kanan Jarrus]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-kananjarrus022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/kananjarrus.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/kananjarrus.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•See-Threepio”. Text: “[Pilot] 1. While present with an Imperial (or two Rebels), all immunity to attrition here is canceled.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): '''First published 27 November 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/hires/kananjarrus.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a75a24b55e5f97960ae23af599fb5f767e24e80c commit a75a24b]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 1 December 2022<ref name="img-kananjarruseb53af7">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/kananjarrus.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af72c4491442a863d743950ff8a472ed77b3 commit eb53af7] (1 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/kananjarrus.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “See-Threepio”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “[Pilot] 1. While present with an Imperial (or two Rebels), all immunity to attrition here is canceled.”
